Class ScenarioPerformanceOptionsSection

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioPerformanceOptionsSection
public class ScenarioPerformanceOptionsSection extends Object

Scenario Performance Options Section

Modular UI builder for simulation performance optimizations, approximations, multi-threaded execution, and strict academic bit-to-bit determinism toggle.
